notes: Prepared double-precision data in both cases; file parsing and initial library/pipeline startup excluded.
Plotly initial timing includes two requestAnimationFrame callbacks and a WebGL finish; native timing includes AppKit plot construction and offscreen Metal render/readback.
Pan timings have different synchronization paths and must not be interpreted as an FPS comparison.
WebKit GPU/network services are excluded from the Plotly memory figures; native figure covers its whole process.
One-off migration observations, not controlled power or total GPU-memory measurements.
